title: OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications for 2026
attributed_claim_summary: OWASP published practitioner-reviewed agentic-application risk guidance spanning agent goal hijack, tool misuse, identity/privilege abuse and agentic supply-chain security.
evidence_or_event: Original OWASP agentic Top 10 resource dated December 9, 2025; practitioner security guidance rather than an intervention trial.
limitations: The named risk categories do not establish quantitative prevalence, vulnerability status of a package or the protective effect of a checklist without independent operational testing.
research_relevance: Make reuse-first agents reject incompatible licensing, suspicious tool/plugin provenance and unauthorized side effects, not optimize only code-generation speed.
practical_experiment: Create an offline secret-free negative-test suite for tool misuse, untrusted retrieval and permission escalation; record independent pass/failure before task integration.
